FAQ

Got questions?

If it's not here, send us a message and we'll sort you out

Is this for beginners?

Yes. There's a beginner option for every current program, so you can start wherever you're at.

Do I need a gym?

The programs are built for the gym, with full sessions ready to go each day.

How does the nutrition side work?

While Kate doesn't provide meal plans, you'll have a daily calorie and macro target, a food log where you can create and add your own recipes, a barcode scanner, and recipe ideas for inspo.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Your plan renews automatically and you can cancel before your next billing date.

Can I pay in Canadian dollars?

Yes. Use the USD / CAD switch above the plans to see pricing and check out in your currency. If you're in Canada we'll show CAD automatically.

What phones does it work on?

The app is available on iPhone and Android. After checkout you'll get an email with your download link and login.
